items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I don't know Snaggs. ... his name was Clifford Jones, but everybody called him Snag. No, I don't know Snaggs. No, I don't know him.

ctx.x: He said, did you ever work with Snaggs? Snaggs? You don't know Snaggs, do you?

Huh? You don't know Snaggs, do you? I don't know Snaggs, do you? I don't know Snaggs, do you? I don't know Snaggs, do you? I don't know Snaggs. He used to play with Kid Oliver all the time in Chicago. He was a drummer from here, his name was Clifford Jones, but everybody called him Snag. No, I don't know Snaggs. No, I don't know him. Did you know a gear punch? Yeah, sure. Everybody know him, but sometimes we used to call a different name. No, I didn't know a nitty-nitty, we called him a light name.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: No, I don't know Snaggs. No, I don't know him.

ctx.x: Eddie Woods. Eddie Woods? Eddie Woods is Faso's name.

Eddie Woods is Faso's name. Eddie Woods, that's his name? Right name, Faso's name? Oh, yeah. You didn't ever say nothing about Snag, Cliff Jones. Yeah, and who did you say? Cliff Jones called him Snag. You remember, Cliff? Oh, yeah. And I'll tell you another, Black Benny was about the best guy in there. You know, bass drum. Bass drum, yeah. Bass drum. You know, in a parade, bass band. But we picked him up before he got killed, put him on Snag. He was good then. But I said he got killed. Yeah, I was really pretty…
